general.title: 通用软件控制（默认）
general.note:
本目录提供 Linux / Windows 传统 GUI 的跨软件控件操作，以及有明确菜单绑定的常见内容命令。当前 Mini 仍只运行 Linux/X11；不能把 Ctrl 机械替换成 Command 后用于 macOS。

运行时维护源为 [`kobe_views/key_tools/catalog.json`](../../kobe_views/key_tools/catalog.json) 的 `toolsets.general.topics`；本文件由 `scripts/render_keyboard_tools.py` 生成。v7 实验原版为 11 个主题、23 条配方，见[逐字节备份](backups/general.2026-10-20.pre-expansion.md)和[来源、实验配置与补充调研](../../docs/taskviews-mini-v7-keyboard-audit-20261020.md)。

使用顺序：先依据当前截图确认活动窗口、控件类型、焦点和模式，再查询一个主题；执行一次按键后重新观察光标、选区、选中标记、数值或弹窗变化。可视焦点、选中状态和业务完成是不同事实。网页控件仅在实现相应键盘交互时适用；ARIA 角色本身不会自动实现快捷键。

每个 `keys` 数组是一次同时按下的组合键；JSON 列表是可选配方，不能整组依次执行。多个步骤必须分成独立调用并观察中间状态，文字/文件路径继续使用原生 `type`。例如先 `<key_lookup>combobox_open</key_lookup>` 打开下拉列表，再查询 `combobox_selection` 选择选项。通用控件主题通过精确 `<key_lookup>主题</key_lookup>` 查询；新计划可依据任务软件名启用专用目录，详见 [使用说明](README.md)。名称匹配不推断当前控件或焦点。

文本编辑只适用于已聚焦的可编辑文本控件。终端、Vim 模式、画布、媒体播放区、时间轴、表格浏览模式和输入法候选窗不能直接套用；同一个箭头键可能移动光标、切换选项、调数值或控制媒体。标准控件不响应时应重新确认焦点或使用当前界面提供的控件，不盲目重复按键。

浏览器地址栏/标签管理、文件重命名、应用缩放、媒体播放、最大化/最小化等继续由 `type.*`、`platform.*`、`app.*` 目录提供。重做的 Ctrl+Y 与 Ctrl+Shift+Z、纯文本粘贴与选择性粘贴也不能当作同一个通用动作。打开/保存/打印仅在当前内容窗口菜单明确支持时使用；保存不等于导出，弹窗消失或工具回执也不证明文件已正确生成。

word_navigation.scope: Focused conventional text field; default word-navigation keymap, no terminal/IME capture.
word_navigation.check: Check caret and selection; word boundaries depend on language and punctuation.

word_selection.scope: Focused conventional text field; extend from the current selection anchor.

recipes.intent: extend selection by one word left
extend selection by one word right

word_selection.check: Inspect the highlighted range before replacing or deleting it.

text_delete.scope: Focused editable text field only; existing selection is deleted as a whole.
text_delete.check: Check the resulting text; outside a text field Delete may remove an item or file.

word_delete.scope: Focused editable text field with no selection; default word-deletion bindings.
word_delete.check: Inspect the text and caret; for a precise range select first, then use text_delete.

multiline_navigation.scope: Focused multiline text editor in text-edit mode; no completion popup or grid focus.

recipes.intent: move caret up one displayed line
move caret down one displayed line

multiline_navigation.check: Verify caret position and scroll offset; wrapping and editor keymaps affect line movement.

multiline_selection.scope: Focused multiline text editor; selection anchored at the current caret.

recipes.intent: extend selection up one displayed line
extend selection down one displayed line

multiline_selection.check: Inspect highlighted text; do not interpret a spreadsheet range as a text selection.

find_text.scope: Content view with Ctrl+F listed as Find/Search; editors, readers or browsers, not a terminal.
find_text.check: Verify the search UI and its scope; type the query separately and inspect actual matches.

document_file.scope: Active document/text/image content window whose File menu lists these bindings; no web-app shortcut capture.
document_file.check: Verify target content, path, format and dialog. Save may prompt; Save As is not Export. Print dialog is not print completion.

menu_open.scope: Desktop application with a native menu/menubar supporting F10; not an arbitrary web page.
menu_open.check: Verify a menu appeared, then use menu_navigation; custom menus may need their visible button.

menu_navigation.scope: Open vertical command menu with keyboard focus; excludes listboxes and text fields.

recipes.intent: activate focused menu item or open its submenu

menu_navigation.check: Read the item label and enabled state before activation; check resulting submenu, dialog or action.

submenu_navigation.scope: Focused item in a conventional left-to-right menu hierarchy with nested submenus.

recipes.intent: open focused item submenu when present
return from submenu to parent menu

submenu_navigation.check: Verify submenu and focus; top-level menubars and reversed layouts can change arrow behavior.

list_navigation.scope: Focused vertical list/listbox implementing standard navigation; Home/End are optional in web lists.
list_navigation.check: Distinguish focus from selection; arrows may select immediately. Home/End do not imply all virtualized items are loaded.

list_selection.scope: Focused multi-select list using modifier-based selection, not a text box; Ctrl+Space must not be captured by IME.

recipes.intent: extend selected range to previous item
extend selected range to next item
toggle focused item without clearing other selections

list_selection.check: Verify selected items/count. Web listboxes may use a different selection model; stop if an IME opens.

list_focus.scope: Focused vertical multi-select list with modifier-based focus navigation.

recipes.intent: focus previous item while retaining selection
focus next item while retaining selection

list_focus.check: Confirm focus moved but selected items stayed unchanged before list_selection.

combobox_open.scope: Focused dropdown/combobox with Alt+Down support; optional in WAI-ARIA widgets.

recipes.intent: open combobox option popup if supported

combobox_open.check: Verify the popup opened; otherwise use its visible opener. Do not apply this to ordinary text.

combobox_selection.scope: Open combobox list popup with option-navigation focus; not a calendar/grid popup.
combobox_selection.check: Verify the committed field value; highlight alone may be provisional. Escape may clear editable input.

radio_group.scope: Focused standard radio group outside a toolbar; horizontal arrow navigation supported.
radio_group.check: Check the filled radio indicator; arrows may change the value immediately. Tab leaves the group.

slider_adjust.scope: Focused horizontal slider using normal left=decrease/right=increase and Home/End endpoints; no canvas focus.
slider_adjust.check: Read the actual value/units after one key; inverted/RTL sliders can reverse direction. Endpoint keys change the value.

spinbutton_adjust.scope: Focused numeric spinbutton supporting Up/Down stepping; not a plain text field.
spinbutton_adjust.check: Verify value, units, bounds and step size. Use text editing only if direct input is supported.

tablist_navigation.scope: Focus on a tab label in a horizontal tablist implementing arrow navigation; not browser content or editor text.

recipes.intent: activate focused tab if manual activation
activate focused tab with Space if manual activation

tablist_navigation.check: Inspect active tab and panel; focus can activate automatically. Vertical tablists use a different arrow axis.

tree_navigation.scope: Focused tree implementing unmodified-arrow expansion (WAI-ARIA/Windows convention); check keymap first.

recipes.intent: expand collapsed node or enter first child
collapse expanded node or focus parent

tree_navigation.check: Verify node expansion and focus. GNOME documents Shift+arrows for expansion; do not assume all desktop trees match.

window_close.scope: Active application window on Linux/Windows; no desktop-only focus or save dialog pending.
window_close.check: Confirm the intended window; handle Save/Discard/Cancel explicitly. Closing a window is not task completion.

window_menu.scope: Active managed desktop window on Linux/Windows supporting the system window menu.
window_menu.check: Verify the system menu and choose by its visible labels; do not assume localized mnemonic letters.
